articles.title_en: Industry Wage Differentials: A Firm-Based Approach
articles.title_cn: 行业工资差异：基于企业的方法
articles.abstract_en: We revisit the estimation of industry wage differentials using linked employer-employee data. Cross-sectional industry differences overstate pay premiums due to unmeasured heterogeneity. Estimates based on models with person and industry effects understate true premiums: workers who switch to a higher-premium industry typically move from higher-paying firms in their origin industry to lower-paying firms in their destination (and vice versa). The corrected standard deviation of log wage effects is 0.122 across narrowly defined industries and is similar at higher levels of aggregation. Higher-skilled workers sort to higher-pay industries. Premiums and worker sorting are more variable in cities with higher-wage firms and higher-skilled workers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用雇主-雇员匹配数据重新审视行业工资差异的估计。横截面行业差异因未观测异质性而高估了工资溢价。基于包含个人和行业效应模型的估计低估了真实溢价：转向更高溢价行业的工人通常从原行业的高薪企业流向目的地的低薪企业（反之亦然）。经校正的对数工资效应标准差在狭义定义的行业中为0.122，在更高聚合层次上相似。技能更高的工人分类到高薪行业。在拥有更高工资企业和更高技能工人的城市中，溢价和工人分类的变异性更大。

articles.title_en: Household Mobility, Networks, and Gentrification of Minority Neighborhoods in the United States
articles.title_cn: 美国家庭流动性、网络与少数族裔社区绅士化
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the impact of recent gentrification shocks on minority neighborhoods in the 50 largest US labor markets. We show that household moves from a given neighborhood are concentrated to few destinations with similar minority shares and strong network ties, but those neighborhoods are farther away from downtown. Gentrification affects Black neighborhoods by raising house prices, reducing the proportion of Black households, and increasing the share of movers going to neighborhoods with network ties. However, gentrification has negligible effects on Hispanic neighborhoods. Overall labor market area segregation decreases after a gentrification shock because highly Black neighborhoods become less segregated.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了近期绅士化冲击对美国50个最大劳动力市场中少数族裔社区的影响。我们发现，从特定社区迁出的家庭集中在少数几个目的地，这些目的地具有相似的少数族裔比例和强大的网络联系，但这些社区距离市中心更远。绅士化通过提高房价、降低黑人家庭比例以及增加迁往具有网络联系社区的家庭比例来影响黑人社区。然而，绅士化对西班牙裔社区的影响微乎其微。总体而言，绅士化冲击后，劳动力市场区域的隔离程度下降，因为高度黑人化的社区变得不那么隔离。

articles.title_en: Teacher Salaries and Racial Inequality in Educational Attainment in the Midcentury South
articles.title_cn: 教师薪资与二十世纪中叶南方的教育获得中的种族不平等
articles.abstract_en: In the late 1930s, the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People (NAACP) launched a campaign to equalize Black and white teacher salaries in the de jure segregated schools of the American South. We estimate the effect of teacher pay on educational attainment exploiting variation in Black salary gains over time across Southern counties with different Black enrollment shares and across states by whether subsequent policy reinforced or resisted court rulings favorable to the NAACP. Using newly collected county panel data, we find that Black teacher salary gains contributed to the large reductions in racial inequality in school enrollment and grade progression in the South at midcentury.
articles.abstract_cn: 在1930年代末，全国有色人种协进会（NAACP）发起了一场运动，旨在实现美国南方法律上种族隔离学校中黑人与白人教师薪资的平等。我们利用南方各县随时间推移黑人薪资增长的变化，以及各州后续政策是强化还是抵制有利于NAACP的法院裁决，来估计教师薪酬对教育获得的影响。使用新收集的县级面板数据，我们发现黑人教师薪资的增长促成了二十世纪中叶南方在学校入学和年级进步方面种族不平等的大幅减少。

articles.title_en: Skill, Productivity, and Wages: Direct Evidence from a Temporary Help Agency
articles.title_cn: 技能、生产率与工资：来自一家临时帮助机构的直接证据
articles.abstract_en: Firms frequently provide general skill training for workers. Theories propose that labor market frictions entail wage compression, generate larger productivity gains than wage growth to skill acquisition, and motivate a firm to offer general skill training, but few studies directly test them. We use unusually rich data from a temporary help service firm that records both workers’ wages and their productivity as measured by the fees charged to client firms. We find that skill acquired through training and learning by doing increases productivity more than wages, with such wage compression accounting for half of the average 40% productivity growth over 5 years of tenure.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业经常为工人提供一般技能培训。理论提出，劳动力市场摩擦会导致工资压缩，使技能获取带来的生产率增长大于工资增长，并促使企业提供一般技能培训，但很少有研究直接检验这些理论。我们使用来自一家临时帮助服务企业的异常丰富的数据，该数据记录了工人的工资以及以向客户企业收取的费用衡量的生产率。我们发现，通过培训和干中学获得的技能对生产率的提高大于对工资的提高，这种工资压缩占平均40%生产率增长的一半，该增长发生在5年的任期内。

articles.title_en: Caregiving and Labor Supply: New Evidence from Administrative Data
articles.title_cn: 照护与劳动供给：来自行政数据的新证据
articles.abstract_en: A significant share of the rapidly growing demand for long-term care is met by family members, many of whom also work, and family caregiving has been shown to affect labor market outcomes. We use survey responses about family caregiving roles linked to administrative earnings records to estimate the employment trajectories of family caregivers over a 25-year period around the reported start of a caregiving episode. These trajectories vary significantly by gender. Relative to a matched comparison group, caregiving precipitates a drop in both earnings and employment for women, while men enter caregiving only after experiencing significant labor supply disruptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 在快速增长的长期照护需求中，有相当大一部分由家庭成员满足，其中许多人同时也有工作，而家庭照护已被证明会影响劳动力市场结果。我们使用关于家庭照护角色的调查回答，并将其与行政收入记录相关联，以估计家庭照护者在所报告的照护事件开始前后一个25年期间的就业轨迹。这些轨迹因性别而显著不同。相对于匹配的对照组，照护导致女性的收入和就业均下降，而男性只有在经历显著的劳动供给中断之后才进入照护。

articles.title_en: Geographic Variation in Cesarean Sections in the United States: Trends, Correlates, and Other Interesting Facts
articles.title_cn: 美国剖宫产的地理差异：趋势、相关因素及其他有趣事实
articles.abstract_en: Analyzing data spanning three decades covering the near universe of births, we study county-level differences in C-section rates among first-time mothers of singleton births. Our research reveals persistent geographic variation in C-section rates for both low- and high-risk groups. Counties with elevated C-section rates consistently perform more C-sections across mothers at all levels of appropriateness for the procedure. These elevated rates of C-section in counties with high C-section rates are associated with reduced maternal and infant morbidity. We also find that C-section decisions are less responsive to underlying risks for Black mothers relative to white mothers, suggesting potential welfare-reducing disparities.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过分析跨越三十年、覆盖几乎所有出生人口的数据，我们研究了初次生育单胎母亲中剖宫产率的县级差异。我们的研究揭示了低风险和高风险群体剖宫产率持续存在的地理差异。剖宫产率较高的县在所有适宜性水平的母亲中均持续实施更多剖宫产。剖宫产率高的县中这些较高的剖宫产率与孕产妇和婴儿发病率降低相关。我们还发现，相对于白人母亲，剖宫产决策对黑人母亲潜在风险的响应较弱，表明可能存在降低福利的差异。

articles.title_en: The Value of Student Debt Relief and the Role of Administrative Barriers: Evidence from the Teacher Loan Forgiveness Program
articles.title_cn: 学生债务减免的价值与行政障碍的作用：来自教师贷款豁免计划的证据
articles.abstract_en: We explore how much borrowers value student debt relief in the setting of the federal Teacher Loan Forgiveness program, which cancels between $5,000 and $17,500 in debt for teachers at high-need schools. Using both quasi-experimental evidence and a randomized controlled trial, we find that neither eligibility nor a targeted information intervention affects employment decisions. Information was found to increase application and receipt rates for teachers who had achieved eligibility. Evidence from contingent valuation surveys suggests that teachers do in general value debt relief. Incorporating qualitative evidence, we conclude that take-up may be constrained by program complexity and administrative barriers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了在联邦教师贷款豁免计划背景下，借款人如何评估学生债务减免的价值，该计划为在高需求学校任教的教师免除5,000美元至17,500美元的债务。利用准实验证据和一项随机对照试验，我们发现，无论是资格条件还是一项有针对性的信息干预，均未影响就业决策。研究发现，信息提高了已获得资格教师的申请率和获得率。条件价值评估调查的证据表明，教师总体上确实重视债务减免。结合定性证据，我们得出结论：参与率可能受到计划复杂性和行政障碍的制约。

articles.title_en: The Employment and Distributional Impacts of Nationwide Minimum Wage Changes
articles.title_cn: 全国最低工资变化的就业与分配影响
articles.abstract_en: We assess the impact of nationwide minimum wages on employment throughout the whole wage distribution by exploiting geographical variation in the level of wages. We find a substantial increase in wages at the bottom of the wage distribution, while we detect a small, statistically insignificant negative effect on employment. Combining the estimated change in the wage distribution with a tax and benefit microsimulation model, we show that the minimum wage generates considerable proportional income gains up to the middle of the household income distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过利用工资水平的地理差异，评估全国最低工资对整个工资分布中就业的影响。我们发现工资分布底部的工资大幅上升，同时我们检测到对就业有一个小的、统计上不显著的负向效应。将估计的工资分布变化与税收和福利微观模拟模型相结合，我们表明最低工资在家庭收入分布的中部之前产生了相当大比例的收入增长。

articles.title_en: Comparing the Effects of Policies for the Labor Market Integration of Refugees
articles.title_cn: 比较难民劳动力市场融入政策的效果
articles.abstract_en: This paper reviews, reanalyzes, and extends to the long run the estimated effects of integration polices on the employment probability and earnings of refugees in Denmark. We first describe the dynamics of labor market outcomes of refugees in Denmark. We then find that increased language training and initial placement in strong labor markets improved refugees’ long-run labor market outcomes, while cutting initial welfare payments and placing refugees near other refugees did not improve them. Policies focused on matching refugees with occupations experiencing shortages have positive short-run effects, but we cannot yet assess their long-run effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文回顾、重新分析并将融合政策对丹麦难民就业概率和收入估计效果的考察扩展至长期。我们首先描述丹麦难民劳动力市场结果的动态变化。随后我们发现，增加语言培训和将难民初始安置在强劲的劳动力市场改善了难民的长期劳动力市场结果，而削减初始福利支付和将难民安置在其他难民附近并未改善这些结果。聚焦于将难民与存在短缺的职业进行匹配的政策具有正向短期效果，但我们尚无法评估其长期效果。

articles.title_en: Unemployment Insurance (UI) Benefit Generosity and Labor Supply from 2002 to 2020: Evidence from California UI Records
articles.title_cn: 失业保险（UI）福利慷慨度与劳动力供给：来自加利福尼亚州UI记录的证据，2002至2020
articles.abstract_en: This paper obtains comparable estimates of the effect of unemployment insurance (UI) benefits on labor supply throughout the unemployment spell and over the business cycle using a regression kink design and 20 years of administrative data from California. For a given unemployment duration, the behavioral effect of UI benefit levels on labor supply does not vary with the business cycle from 2002 to 2019. However, due to increased coverage from extensions in benefit durations, the duration elasticity of UI benefits rises during recessions. The behavioral effect during the start of the COVID-19 pandemic is substantially lower at all unemployment durations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文使用回归扭结设计和加利福尼亚州20年的行政数据，获得了失业保险（UI）福利对劳动力供给在整个失业持续期内以及在整个经济周期中的可比估计。对于给定的失业持续时间，UI福利水平对劳动力供给的行为效应在2002至2019期间不随经济周期而变化。然而，由于福利期限延长带来的覆盖范围增加，UI福利的持续时间弹性在经济衰退期间上升。在COVID-19疫情开始期间，所有失业持续时间下的行为效应都大幅降低。

articles.title_en: The Expanding Landscape of Online Education: Who Engages and How They Fare
articles.title_cn: 在线教育版图的扩张：谁参与其中，表现又如何
articles.abstract_en: Online university courses have become common, though some question whether the modality can adequately substitute for an in-person experience. We explore online course enrollment and student outcomes at a large public 4-year system. Online enrollment nearly doubled from 2012 to 2019. Female students and older students were especially likely to take online classes. Students earned more As and Fs in online courses, but semester grade point averages were higher in terms when students took at least one class online. Importantly, taking higher shares of courses online was associated with increased degree completion, with the largest benefits for younger students and male students.
articles.abstract_cn: 大学在线课程已变得普遍，尽管有人质疑这种模式能否充分替代面授体验。我们考察了一所大型公立4年制系统中的在线课程注册与学生成果。在线注册人数从2012到2019几乎翻倍。女学生和年龄较大的学生尤其可能选修在线课程。学生在在线课程中获得更多的A和F，但在学生至少选修一门在线课程的学期中，学期平均绩点更高。重要的是，在线修课比例越高与学位完成率提高相关，其中对较年轻学生和男学生的益处最大。
